task.title: Resolve Conflicts with AI
task.shortdesc: Use AI to analyze a conflicted file, review a proposed resolution, and apply the result to the working copy.

context.p: When a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or stash pop produces a conflict, you can use Resolve with AI to generate a suggested resolution. The AI analyzes the conflicted file and its common ancestor, then opens a review dialog where you can inspect, edit, and apply the proposed result.
context.note: This feature requires the Positron AI Assistant add-on.

step.cmd: In the Git Staging view, right-click a conflicted file in the Unstaged files area.
Open the Resolve Conflict submenu and choose Resolve with AI.
Review the explanation and the AI-generated resolution in the dialog.
Use the comparison actions to compare the proposed result with Mine, Theirs, or the conflicted file.
Edit the AI suggestion if needed, or use Restore Original AI Suggestion to return to the initial proposal.

result.p: The resolved content is written to the working copy and the file is staged automatically.

postreq.p: You can customize AI conflict-resolution behavior in the Git Client AI preferences page by adding project-specific instructions.
